correctness.rationale: For \(n\ge7\) each nonedge in the antihole has full geodesic hull after two closure rounds, forcing proper convex sets to be cliques, hence independent sets of C_n. The shattered-support characterization and polynomial follow by exact traces and cyclic-gap counting. A hereditary independent-set family has online dimension alpha; the augmented-path recurrence is proved for all m>=0 with both parity cases, and the antihole first-query branches are exactly I(P_{n-1}) and the augmented P_{n-3} class. The formulas include all boundary \(n=7\) and \(m=0\) cases. The independent distance/trace/online checker corroborates n<=14, not extrapolated as proof.

value.rationale: Antiholes are natural complements of induced cycles, with odd antiholes serving as basic perfect-graph obstructions. The theorem exactly enumerates all possible shattered supports, not merely the maximum, and identifies a sharp odd/even transition in the optimal adversarial online depth. This is an infinite all-order structural learning invariant; the parity mechanism depends on the one-top path recursion and is not just a restatement of the classical cycle independence polynomial.
